hurst_estimates.method: Log-structure function: slope of log E[|Δ_h log_RV|^2] vs log(h), lags 1-20, IS only

fGN_uni_vs_HAR.sign_convention: d = loss_fGN_uni - loss_HAR; t>0 => fGN-uni WORSE; t<0 => fGN-uni BETTER

fGN_multi_vs_HAR.sign_convention: d = loss_fGN_multi - loss_HAR; t>0 => fGN-multi WORSE; t<0 => fGN-multi BETTER

caveats: Evaluation alignment fix (H1): predictions at index t represent forecast for t+1; actual_rv uses shift(-1) to compare against rv[t+1]. n_eval = n_oos - 1.
H2: fGN-multi cross-asset correction uses realized (not predicted) lag-1 residuals of other assets; feasible since these are one-period lagged values known at forecast time.
lookahead_prevention: HAR: features at t (rv_d/rv_w/rv_m ending at t), target rv_{t+1}. fGN-uni: AR on increments d_t..d_{t-p+1} to predict d_{t+1}, anchor at log_rv_t. fGN-multi: cross-asset uses lag-1 residuals (t-1), no contemporaneous cross info.
